name: Barreling Overrun (Combat)
body:
You can overrun multiple targets.

Prerequisite: Str 13, Improved Overrun, Power Attack

Benefit: When using the overrun combat maneuver, you may overrun any number of opponents in your movement path so long as you move in a straight line. If you fail a combat maneuver check at any point, the maneuver ends as normal.

Special: This feat may be taken by animals.
